# WO-190: Guard human-readable registry priority ordering (CP-36)
Status: review
Vendor: codex
Agent: app-features
Owner contact: Nora Bennett (check-ins via CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Target release: v0.3.0
Assigned to: Ravi Menon
Source: CP-36 / freemyid-pm#162; read-only candidate scan by Ravi Menon

## Goal
Add a focused test for the visible row ordering in the human-readable `registry show` command.

## Acceptance criteria
- Add `tests/codex/test_cx_cli_registry_table.py`.
- Invoke `registry show` without `--json`, supplying only three synthetic brokers with unique IDs and distinct priorities in deliberately shuffled input order.
- Assert the command succeeds, each ID appears exactly once, and displayed table row positions follow descending priority.
- Keep the test hermetic: monkeypatch the registry accessor; do not load the real registry, store, network, or user data. Use fake names/IDs only.
- Run the focused pytest and Ruff; record exact commands/results in the worktree `VENDOR_STATUS.md`.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- `tests/codex/test_cx_cli_registry_table.py` (new)
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Out of scope / do not touch
No `src/`, registry/schema files, existing tests, CLI output, JSON contract, malformed invocation, profile scoping, store, configuration, CI, or dependencies. This is coverage of existing behavior, not a product fix.

## Check-in plan
Worktree `.vendor-wt/wo-190` on `vendor/wo-190`, based on latest owner-prepared local main. Confirm the worktree exists before editing. If the existing output cannot be asserted without source changes, report the evidence and stop. Post results on issue #162; Nora updates `docs/vendor/CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md`.
